source.description: Synthetic prior-session open-market BUY followed by a locked-lower-limit SELL on a later session, used only to verify a real held Portfolio position and sell reservation rejection/release

expectedAssertions.description: A prior-session open-market BUY creates a real Portfolio/FakeBroker holding
A locked-lower SELL with a real sell reservation is rejected, releases only that reservation, and leaves holdings and ledgers unchanged
